metadataRaw.title: How to Get FAST Lower Back Arthritis Pain Relief (Ages 55+)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shares safe, easy exercises designed to relieve lower back arthritis symptoms, including stiffness, aching, and muscle tightness.

These gentle movements target common conditions such as spinal osteoarthritis (wear-and-tear arthritis), spinal stenosis, and degenerative disc disease. They help stretch and strengthen the spine while keeping your lower back in a safe, comfortable position.

The exercises are simple, straightforward, and designed specifically for adults age 55 and older.

Best of all, no equipment is needed, and some exercises may provide relief in as little as 30 seconds.

Watch now and quickly relieve lower back arthritis pain from the comfort of your home.
